description: This file defines the class SugarFieldEnum, which extends SugarFieldBase, providing methods for rendering and processing enumeration fields in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It includes methods for generating view templates, sanitizing imported values, and formatting field display, specifically for enum type fields.

classes.name: SugarFieldEnum
classes.description: A class managing the display and processing of enumeration fields within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Returns the Smarty template or output for the detail view of the enum field, possibly using a custom function if specified.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Returns the Smarty template or output for editing the enum field, using a default size if none is specified.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Returns the Smarty template or output for the search view of the enum field.

methods.name: displayFromFunc
methods.description: Delegates display rendering to a specific function based on display type, or falls back to default methods.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates imported values for the enum field, matching display values or keys case-insensitively.

methods.name: formatField
methods.description: Formats the raw field value using the options array to get a human-readable label.
